notes.title: Limited TIME Demo / NEW GAME Sit-Back Attack! Try it now!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Stapleton here.
Sit-Back Attack's demo is closing up in 2 days!
Now is the time to try our new game in development!

It might be coming back online around the 14th for a preview into the Steam Next Fest, but we are unsure!
So if you want to check it out, do so now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092260/SitBack_Attack/

 50+ playable characters!

To anyone reading this, thank you for supporting my previous games!
And also thank you for reading this!

I've laid down improvement plans for other games I've released. Especially improving UI.
To get a taste of what we mean, try out this demo and let me know if we're on the right track!

Thanks!
- Stapleton

notes.title: 75% OFF! Future of Card Battles - Stapleton
notes.content:
Hello everyone whom this may concern.
It is Stapleton back for another talk the talk and not walk the walk.
Well let me tell you.
That day is changing.

Recently, DPSII (a newly formed publisher) and I have merged our intelligence to
form a sort of... Super group.
Besides it isn't super. We're just normal people trying to make interesting video games shine.

The fact of the matter is this...
Card Battles will be remade.
This is going to be vastly improved in this fateful year of 2025.
These improvements will include:
- Complete renovation of the UI system
- A new battle system that will have a random deck of 30 card to choose from
- New challenges
- New Cards
- New and Improved visuals.

Call it Card Battles 2.0

These improvements must wait however. 
As a full time project has kidnapped all our time.
It is called Sit-Back Attack and it is coming along nicely.
A demo was just released for the Idler Fest. Check it out!

From all that I have learned in the past few years, I cannot leave these games high and dry.
I make it a goal to at least give the UI systems a good polishing.

Thanks for reading!
- Stapleton

notes.title: MANY MANY UPDATES!
notes.content:
Hey everyone. A big patch just came in and includes many new features including the Tournament!

Patched is released!
Redesigned Shadow Dragon to add TAUNT.
Redesigned Coatlicue to heals
Fixed Forgemaster.
Updated humans to include Crusade and Rally.
Nerfed angels sacrifice by increasing the amount they must be healed to resurrect after sacrificing.
Redesigned Cenarius.
Added in a few new cards, including Living Tome: Adds TAUNT to adjacent cards!
Added in 7 NEW playable characters. One for every element!
Changed how AI behaves in a multitude of ways to be more intuitive.
Also added in random AI for the Tournament of Power.
Redesigned ALL Ultra-Bosses.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613375/f38851f1f6699aa0c9e861d810bb791a9117ca57.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613375/6f1716e105ecb44f6204032ccae79a2d7461fb79.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613375/819fc56bc2d5ba306e97a7a502eb0d24c2db28c7.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613375/843ab29e1d75f9933cf34ae59357dabb6ab3a313.png

ADDED IN THE TOURNAMENT OF POWER!
- Choose from ALL 16 playable characters and form a build depending on which Division you choose.
- Face up against 15 opponents to attempt to become the Champion! And become a part of the Hall of Champions!
- AI is more sporadic giving a RNG element to the game for the first time.
- Can skip or watch opponents battles as you wish.
- Many, many MANY different builds.
Added some QOL improvements as well.
